propositions: A new advisory plan-review criterion must be authored and registered to require plans that add or alter failure/timeout/exception/retry/fallback semantics to explicitly state their failure-disposition contract (what disposition surfaces per affected arm and which wins on fallback-failure).

The criterion must be scoped as a project-overlay (1-TURN exec, container+leaf scope, advisory posture, not suppressing bugs) and must not block claims, enabling it to catch config-only changes like the incident-1c0d origin (8fbd's rebar.toml fallback flip).

The rubric must include two checklist sub-answers: a GATE determining whether the plan affects failure semantics (not-applicable → PASS) and a REQ checking that per-affected-arm disposition is stated and fallback-failure winners preserve the most-recoverable leg (the incident root cause).

Implementation must include a hand-authored seven-case sanity eval corpus (three TP/four TN paired cases) with a frozen operator-attested baseline committing expected recall=1.0/false-accept=0.0 and an offline unit test pinning registration, rubric structure, routing, eval shape, and escalated-bug-vs-light-bug-tier behavior.

The criterion must be documented in docs/plan-review-gate.md and reachable via rebar explain, and must avoid double-flagging with T5b by citing the disposition-contract gap specifically in the rubric.

Implementation includes no deterministic block-floor; any future blocking promotion must follow the standard dogfood-gated advisory→blocking path gated on field-data effectiveness metrics, not offline corpus calibration.
